Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: GH Actions integration for OSS model runners

Hi Marissa,

I signed up for Redwood this morning (loving the quick start!) and we are evaluating it for an OSS model runner we maintain at GraphForge. Two quick questions before a demo: does Redwood provide a GitHub App or is the integration via Actions/webhooks? Also curious about any guidance for artifact storage — we try to avoid egress where possible.

Would love a 30-minute demo to see the integration flow and how it would look with our repos. I’m available Mon/Tue next week in the afternoons PST (after 1pm). I can bring our lead engineer, Luca (cc’ed).

Thanks,
Kelsey
Head of Platform — GraphForge

Hi Kelsey — great to meet you, and welcome aboard!

We definitely support multiple integration patterns: a GitHub App for org-level installs, webhook + Actions runner flows for repo-level automation, and guidance for minimizing egress by pinning artifacts to object storage in-region. We can walk through the options in a short demo.

I’ve got the following 30-min windows next week (all PDT):
- Mon Apr 12, 2:00–2:30pm
- Tue Apr 13, 3:30–4:00pm

If those don’t work, here’s a quick calendar to pick a time: https://calendly.com/marissa/reddemo-30

I can bring one of our integration engineers for the technical bits; would you prefer that? I’ve attached a short sales MAP that outlines topics we typically cover.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Thanks, Marissa — both slots conflict with a board review. Can we push to Wed/Thu? Our timezone is PST. Also a couple of technical clarifications so we can prep:

1) Which flow gives us the best security posture for an OSS org that wants limited permissions? (GitHub App vs lightweight Actions + webhook)
2) Do you have a sample runbook or architecture sketch for running Redwood from GH-hosted runners vs self-hosted? We try to avoid long-lived credentials in our CI.

I attached a short internal runbook draft so you can see our setup. Luca will be the technical attendee.

—Kelsey
